name: static-release-checks
command: for (const name of ["product:verify","projections:check","scan:fences","scan:knowhow","oss:check"]) { const {spawnSync}=await import("node:child_process"); const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,["--env-file=.env","../../pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs",name],{stdio:"inherit"}); if(r.status!==0) process.exit(r.status??1); }
